cases.query: When a Pino source using a custom level formatter relays a string level label through the metadata protocol, multistream silently drops the record. Preserve numeric-level behavior and ensure an error record identified by the string label reaches every eligible destination. Add a focused regression test.
Custom formatters emit text level labels, but records disappear when a logger routes them through multiple streams. Find the routing implementation and its tests.
The metadata protocol can forward lastLevel as the string error. Destination threshold comparisons should still deliver the record to debug and error streams.
